title: Invoice email to a sheet row
summary: Details are extracted from an emailed invoice, the amounts are checked, and one row is added to your invoices table; incomplete or inconsistent invoices are held for review.

requirements.purpose: The invoices table that receives one row per invoice (unique on vendor and invoice number).
An inbound email webhook that delivers {from, subject, body} with the invoice text.

success_criteria: A complete invoice whose net plus tax equals its total adds one row with the invoice number, vendor, currency, net, tax and total exactly as written.
An invoice with a missing amount or amounts that do not add up adds no row and is held for review with the reason.
The same vendor and invoice number never adds a second row.

config.prompt: Extract the invoice from the upstream email. Personal details may already be privacy placeholders: retain them as obscured values, never reconstruct them. Return {"complete": bool, "net_plus_tax": number or null, "invoice": {"invoice_number", "vendor", "invoice_date", "currency", "net", "tax", "total"}, "parameters": [invoice_number, vendor, invoice_date, currency, net, tax, total]}. Extract only stated values, with null for missing values. invoice_date is optional, including a redacted date as null. complete is true exactly when invoice_number, vendor, currency, net, tax and total are present. All monetary values and their parameter entries are JSON numbers without currency symbols or thousands separators. Calculate net_plus_tax by adding the extracted net and tax; do not change a stated amount or invent an adjustment. The deterministic downstream Gate compares this sum with the stated total; do not return a consistency decision.

success_criteria: Each extracted field and parameter matches the email; missing values are null, never guessed.
complete is correct for the six required fields; the date is optional.
All monetary values and parameters are JSON numbers without separators, and net_plus_tax equals the extracted net plus tax.

arguments.statement: INSERT INTO invoices (invoice_number, vendor, invoice_date, currency, net, tax, total) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) ON CONFLICT (vendor, invoice_number) DO NOTHING

config.prompt: The invoice in the upstream output was not added. Respond with {"status": "needs_review", "reason": one sentence naming the missing field or the amounts that do not add up}. The invoice_date is optional and never a reason for review. If net_plus_tax differs from invoice.total, report that arithmetic mismatch even if an upstream consistent flag incorrectly says true. Only invoice_number, vendor, currency, net, tax and total are mandatory.

success_criteria: reason names the actual missing field or arithmetic mismatch.

test_cases.name: consistent invoice adds a row

input.subject: Invoice SP-1042
input.body:
Sharma Print Works
Invoice number: SP-1042
Net: INR 12,000.00
GST 18%: INR 2,160.00
Total due: INR 14,160.00

success_criteria: One row is added with invoice number SP-1042, vendor Sharma Print Works, currency INR, net 12000.00, tax 2160.00 and total 14160.00.
The invoice is not held for review.

test_cases.name: amounts that do not add up are held

input.subject: Invoice 77
input.body:
Northwind Supplies
Invoice 77
Net: USD 500.00
Tax: USD 45.00
Total: USD 600.00

success_criteria: The workflow selects hold_for_review and produces zero database.insert actions.
The invoice is held for review because 500.00 plus 45.00 does not equal 600.00.
